findings.title: Filtering truthy values in from_runnable_config drops boolean configuration fields set to False
findings.impact: Configuration options with boolean values defaulting to or explicitly set to False are filtered out because False is falsy, causing them to unexpectedly revert to dataclass default values.
findings.preconditions: Calling from_runnable_config when a boolean config option is passed via configurable or env vars.
findings.explanation: In Python, bool values like False evaluate to falsy in boolean contexts. The expression if v drops any configuration key whose resolved value is False.
findings.suggestion: return cls(**{k: v for k, v in values.items() if v is not None})

findings.title: Environment variables are retrieved as raw strings without type conversion
findings.impact: Integer or boolean configuration fields loaded from environment variables remain strings, leading to type mismatches.
findings.explanation: os.environ.get returns a string and it is passed directly into cls without coercion.
